profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm a Software Developer,  I enjoy solving problems and building products.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-  Developed a web application for Garage Project Hub using node.js, that feeds information from facebook pages and formats the information to be displayed on a physical dashboard.

-  Developed a web frontend using React web framework for the physical dashboard, to allow users to choose what information they want to display on their personalized dashboard.

positions.title: Freelance Developer
positions.description: Using .NET stack, implemented a desktop client that allows users to manage student registration, payment and assistance amongst other features.

positions.title: Assistant Civil Engineer
positions.description:
● Under the supervision of a senior civil engineer, worked on several land development

housing projects.

● Created volume tables and comprehensive reports on land movement based cross

section profiles, including the creation of graphs and blueprints to show in-­depth results

of the project.
